the runtime answers the pending request 202 and returns the fn's Response once resumed).\n\nNow propose the change set with this single file.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_lJW1IFU5ZCk1CJKQuONz1878","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{\"changes\": [{\"file\": \"handler.ts\", \"content\": \"import { run, waitSignal, signal } from \\\"zttp:durable\\\";\\n\\nstructural ApprovalProof<T> = Proof<T,\\n  | \\\"deterministic\\\"\\n  | \\\"retry_safe\\\"\\n  | \\\"idempotent\\\"\\n  | \\\"state_isolated\\\"\\n  | \\\"result_safe\\\"\\n  | \\\"optional_safe\\\"\\n  | \\\"no_secret_leakage\\\"\\n  | \\\"no_credential_leakage\\\"\\n  | \\\"input_validated\\\"\\n  | \\\"pii_contained\\\"\\n  | \\\"injection_safe\\\"\\n  | \\\"canonical\\\"\\n  | \\\"cost_bounded\\\"\\n>;\\n\\nexport function handler(req: Request): ApprovalProof<Response> {\\n  const key = req.headers.get(\\\"Idempotency-Key\\\");\\n  if (key === undefined) {\\n    return Response.json({ error: \\\"missing Idempotency-Key\\\" }, { status: 400 });\\n  }\\n  if (req.method === \\\"POST\\\" && req.path === \\\"/signal\\\") {\\n    const delivered = signal(key, \\\"approval\\\", { approved: true });\\n    return Response.json({ delivered: delivered });\\n  }\\n  if (req.method !== \\\"POST\\\" || req.path !== \\\"/wait\\\") {\\n    return Response.json({ error: \\\"not found\\\" }, { status: 404 });\\n  }\\n  return run(key, () => {\\n    const approval = waitSignal(\\\"approval\\\");\\n    return Response.json({ approved: approval !== undefined });\\n  });\\n}\\n\"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":13583,"completion_tokens":601,"total_tokens":14184,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":4096},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":85},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":4096,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":9487},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
